content: X/Twitter terminal-client landscape (2026-10-14): all live X TUIs authenticate with browser session cookies to x.com's internal GraphQL (xeet 73*, pushed 2026-09-17, write-capable; XTUI 1*, read-only via browser extension+native host; omaX 0*, Omarchy/Kitty themed, write-capable; x-tui 0*, Bun+Ink, inline images; twit 14*, cookies in config.yaml, burner-account warning). Official-API clients remain alive but paid (x-cli 5.6k*, twty 291*). Dead: twterm, rainbowstream, oysttyer, nekome, twnyan, earthquake, tyrs, turses, tweetstreem, gockel, rtv/tuir. Killed by: Jan-2023 third-party client cutoff and developer-terms rewrite; abolition of the free API tier; cease-and-desist against Nitter/XCancel (archived 2026-09-11); maintainer burnout/dependency rot (rtv->tuir stalled on bundled PRAW3); query-ID rotation. Gap: nothing is read-only, plain-text/unbranded, browser-independent, and no-timeline-on-disk at once.
